name: adv_naming_stream_vs_connect_binding
source:
// Positional stream binding names variables after the STREAM (f1$p); connect
// binding names them after the PORT (va$in$p). Both in one document.
Source SRC(f1, fluid$ = Water, mdot = 2.0, P = 400000, T = 330)
Valve  VA(f1, f2, Cv = 0.01, rho = 980, u = 1)
Sink   SK(f2)
f2.P = 350000

ThermalSource HOT(T = 400)
Conduction    CD(k = 10, area = 1, L = 0.1)
ThermalSource COLD(T = 300)
connect(HOT.port, CD.a)
connect(CD.b, COLD.port)
m  = f2.mdot
q  = CD.Q
ta = CD.a.T

error.message: There are 22 equations and 21 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): f2.P=350000. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
